purpose: First system-level closed loop: one agent, one world, one chronological experience stream exercising control discovery (M1), identity retention (M2), and vision-only object permanence (M4-unprivileged) simultaneously
verification_inputs: Component attribution: shadow-casting, reachable floor, and filter painting are load-bearing; pause learner and re-anchor are not required (V2_M4_UNPRIVILEGED_VERIFICATION.md)
Sensitivity: the reachable floor's guarantee requires object speed at most one cell per step
Seed sweep: mean-level gates replicate on 100 fresh seeds but per-seed variance is large; paired formal-vs-control comparisons are the stable signal

environment.camera: fixed at the grid center; the 11x11 window covers the entire active arena, so no entity is ever out of view - hiding is caused only by line-of-sight occlusion
environment.arena: all movers and the self point are confined to columns/rows 7..17
environment.objects: one vertical screen segment and two seed-jittered static blocks; one self point moved by the commanded action each step; two autonomous distractor points with bounce dynamics, one seeded to cross the self path
environment.occlusion_model: discrete line-of-sight over Bresenham rays from the camera cell
environment.agent_observation: an 11x11 patch of visibly occupied cells only, plus the executed action copy; no visibility channel, no identity labels, no coordinates
environment.evaluation_only: true positions, identities, and visibility, used exclusively for scoring

formal_agent.mechanism: a single agent instance consuming one (sensed patch, action copy) pair per step: shadow-casting visibility inference; isolated-detection entity tracks with probabilistic identity; per-track online action-displacement control scoring for self discovery; the unprivileged occupancy machinery (log-odds fusion, reachable-floor painting) for non-self permanence
constraints: exactly one agent object; one update per world step; chronological; zero replay
update() accepts the sensed patch and action copy only
no component may read simulator internals or labels

required_mechanism_controls.no_action_input: the agent receives a random action copy instead of the executed one; self-identification must collapse
required_mechanism_controls.assume_all_visible: shadow-casting disabled; hidden-distractor permanence must collapse
required_mechanism_controls.time_shuffled_action: action copies delayed/shuffled in time; self-identification must degrade by at least the preregistered drop

gate_design_note: Mean gates inherit the M1/M4 stage thresholds. The paired-fraction gate responds to the seed-sweep finding that mean-level control separation hides per-seed overlap: the formal agent must beat the assume_all_visible control on hidden-distractor probability in at least 75% of paired seeds.
decision_rule: Development passing every fixed gate authorizes exactly one holdout run. A passing holdout establishes the first verified system-level loop and authorizes extending the integrated agent toward the body-graph (M3) capability. A failing holdout cannot be repaired by rerunning holdout seeds or editing this protocol.
